label: Galaxy S21 5G smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy S21 5G — 6.2-inch flagship, Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and 5G sub-6/mmWave; USB-C 3.2 port supports DeX docks with Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2 MIMO, 2.4/5 GHz, HE160) — Wi-Fi 5 fallback hardware is not present for 6 GHz. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave (US models), LTE Cat 20. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with Samsung DeX, so a USB-C dock with GbE presents a real Ethernet interface (usb0); Wi-Fi can stay associated while docked, which makes it a good dual-homed client for failover tests.
